description:
Outcome: Coordinator maintains records needed for allocation, from brief.md / Background, First version 2–3 and Rules.
Scope: Ordinary list/forms for 40 stable plot IDs, season dates/timezone, household records and prior-season holdings; manual paper-record import with preview. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Invalid date ranges and duplicate holdings rejected; import atomic; allocation history preserved; prior holdings support priority; timezone configured before deadline-sensitive use.
Behaviour: Confirm corrections; clear validation; no partial import after failure. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Constraint tests and representative preview/import fixtures. Prerequisites: T-003. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Manage seasons, plot records and prior holdings
